correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs normalized digit patterns; in separated exponent cubes, no carries occur and long zero gaps delimit and uniquely identify all primitive patterns and positions. The four-case binary example yields L(L-2) with no double counting. Checker.py tests exact finite claims and generic collisions without pretending to prove infinite asymptotics.
